description: This Java source file defines an Android IntentService class named BigPictureSocialIntentService, which handles asynchronous updates for social notifications, specifically those with BigPictureStyle. It processes incoming intents to add comments to notifications, recreates notifications with new comments, and implements inline reply actions for wearables.

classes.name: BigPictureSocialIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService for handling social notification comments and updates, especially with BigPictureStyle notifications.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Entry point for processing incoming intents, distinguishing actions for comment handling.

methods.name: handleActionComment
methods.description: Processes a comment comment, updates the notification with the new comment, and handles the UI update.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the comment message from the intent via RemoteInput results.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigPictureStyle
methods.description: Recreates a NotificationCompat.Builder configured with BigPictureStyle, with current data, for updating the notification.
